source:
{\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;\C0;①ST11至车辆段第一天(白天)：\P    两台旋挖钻同时施工，每2个墩为一个施工单元，形成循环施工。钻孔时产生钻渣48m³/孔，共计96m³。每台泥浆车容积12m³，需用8台泥浆车清运。\P①	ST11 to Depot, Day 1 (Daytime):
Two rotary drilling rigs operate simultaneously. Every 2 piers form one construction unit to realize cyclic construction. Drilling spoil generated during boring is 48m³ per borehole with a total of 96m³. Each slurry truck has a capacity of 12m³, and 8 slurry trucks are required for removal.}
translation: {\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;\C0;①ST11至车辆段第一天(白天)：\P 两台旋挖钻同时施工，每2个墩为一个施工单元，形成循环施工。钻孔时产生钻渣48m³/孔，共计96m³。每台泥浆车容积12m³，需用8台泥浆车清运。\P① ST11 to Depot, Day 1 (Daytime): Two rotary drilling rigs operate simultaneously. Every 2 piers form one construction unit to realize cyclic construction. Drilling spoil generated during boring is 48m³ per borehole with a total of 96m³. Each slurry truck has a capacity of 12m³, and 8 slurry trucks are required for removal.}

source:
{\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;\C0;②ST11至车辆段第一天（傍晚）：\P    桩基成孔验收完毕，开始钢筋笼吊装作业，使用50t履带吊,作业半径11m，钢筋笼分三次吊装。\P②	ST11 to Depot, Day 1 (Evening):
After inspection and acceptance of completed boreholes for pile foundations, reinforcement cage lifting works commence. A 50t crawler crane is adopted with an operating radius of 11m, and the reinforcement cage is lifted in three segments.}
translation: {\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;\C0;②ST11至车辆段第一天（傍晚）：\P 桩基成孔验收完毕，开始钢筋笼吊装作业，使用50t履带吊,作业半径11m，钢筋笼分三次吊装。\P② ST11 to Depot, Day 1 (Evening): After inspection and acceptance of completed boreholes for cọc foundations, reinforcement cage lifting works commence. A 50t crawler crane is adopted with an operating radius of 11m, and the reinforcement cage is lifted in three segments.}

source:
{\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;\C0;③ST11至车辆段第一天（夜间）：\P    钢筋笼吊装完毕后，进行二次清孔，浇筑桩基混凝土。\P③ Day 1 (Night):
After completion of reinforcement cage lifting, secondary hole cleaning shall be carried out, followed by concreting of pile foundation.}
translation: {\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;\C0;③ST11至车辆段第一天（夜间）：\P 钢筋笼吊装完毕后，进行二次清孔，浇筑桩基混凝土。\P③ Day 1 (Night): After completion of reinforcement cage lifting, secondary hole cleaning shall be carried out, followed by concreting of cọc foundation.}

source:
{\fSimSun|b0|i0|c134|p2;\C0;④ST11站施工第一天（白天）：\P    小里程开始承台钢筋绑扎、混凝土浇筑，ST11车站开始桩基施工。 两台旋挖钻同时施工，每2个墩为一个施工单元，形成循环施工。钻孔时产生钻渣48m³/孔，共计96m³。每台泥浆车容积12m³，需用8台泥浆车清运。\P④ST11 Station, Day 1 (Daytime):
Pile cap reinforcement binding and concrete pouring start at the down-grade section, and pile foundation construction commences at ST11 Station. Two rotary drilling rigs operate simultaneously. Every 2 piers form one construction unit to realize cyclic construction. Drilling spoil generated during boring is 48m³ per borehole with a total of 96m³. Each slurry truck has a capacity of 12m³, and 8 slurry trucks are required for removal.}

Two rotary drilling rigs operate simultaneously. Every 2 piers form one construction unit to realize cyclic construction. Drilling spoil generated during boring is 48m³ per borehole with a total of 96m³. Each slurry truck has a capacity of 12m³, and 8 slurry trucks are required for removal.}
